title: CoreQ: Mismatch-Corrected Successive Rounding for LLM Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2602.05902v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) enables efficient deployment of large language models by mapping pretrained weights to low-bit formats without retraining, typically using a small calibration set to minimize a layer-wise calibration objective. However, this sequential procedure induces a mismatch: errors from earlier quantized layers alter the inputs received by later layers, causing the activations to deviate from those of the full-precision model. Recent approaches introduce mismatch-aware calibration objectives to compensate for this effect, but leave open how much of the observed mismatch should shift each layer's calibration target. We show that fully applying the empirical mismatch correction can overfit finite calibration data, while using a fixed correction coefficient ignores variation in mismatch estimates across layers. translated_title: CoreQ：面向大语言模型量化的失配校正逐次舍入方法
translated_abstract: 后训练量化通过将预训练权重映射为低比特格式而无需重新训练，使大语言模型得以高效部署，通常利用小型校准集来最小化逐层校准目标。然而，这种顺序式流程会引发失配问题：先前量化层的误差会改变后续层接收到的输入，导致激活值偏离全精度模型的激活值。近期方法引入了失配感知的校准目标来补偿这一效应，但对于观察到的失配应在多大程度上偏移每层的校准目标，仍未给出解答。我们证明，完全应用经验失配校正可能导致对有限校准数据的过拟合，而使用固定的校正系数则会忽略各层之间失配估计的差异。为解决这些局限，我们提出了CoreQ——一种免学习的PTQ框架，它使用几何……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: CoreQ是一种免学习的大语言模型后训练量化框架，通过自适应调节逐层失配校正的强度，避免了完全校正导致的校准数据过拟合以及固定校正系数忽略层间差异的问题。
en_tdlr: CoreQ is a learning-free PTQ framework for LLM quantization that adaptively determines the strength of per-layer mismatch correction, avoiding overfitting to limited calibration data while accounting for layer-wise variation in mismatch estimates.
